Přišli jste se podívat na zápas a nevíte: Came to watch a match and not sure why the referee blew the whistle? Here are the rules of floorball in a nutshell. No jargon, with comics and things you can try yourself. For anyone who has never held a floorball stick.

na hřišti: pět hráčů s florbalkou a bran: on the rink: five field players and a goalkeeper
minut čistého času, mezi třetinami pauza: minutes of effective time, with breaks between periods
metrů má hřiště ohraničené mantinelem: metres is the size of the rink, enclosed by a board
Florbal se hraje v hale na hřišti 40 × 2: Floorball is played indoors on a rink of 40 × 20 metres. It is enclosed by a low plastic board with rounded corners. The ball can bounce off it and play goes on.
Hraje se uvnitř mantinelu. Čáry na zemi: The game is played inside the board. The markings on the floor show who may go where and where play restarts.
Nákres florbalového hřiště s vyznačenými: Diagram of a floorball rink with its parts marked
Nakresleno v měřítku. Klepněte na číslo: Drawn to scale. Tap a number or an item in the list.
Ohraničuje hřiště 40 × 20 m. Když míček: Encloses the 40 × 20 m rink. When the ball flies over it, play resumes with a hit-in.
Dělí hřiště na poloviny. Ze středového b: Divides the rink into two halves. Every period, and play after a goal, starts from the centre spot. A penalty shot starts 5 m closer to the goal.
Šest křížků u mantinelů. Na nejbližším z: Six crosses near the board. Play restarts with a face-off on the nearest one.
Území brankáře. Jen tady smí chytat míče: The goalkeeper’s territory. Only here may the goalkeeper catch the ball with the hands. Field players may enter it.
Hned před brankou. Hráči s florbalkou do: Right in front of the goal. Field players must not step into it, not even with one foot. They may reach in with the stick.
Gól platí, když míček celý přejde branko: A goal counts when the whole ball crosses the goal line from the front.
Střídačky obou družstev. Střídat se smí: The benches of both teams. You may substitute at any time and as often as you like, but only here.
Naproti střídačkám, každý tým na stejné: Opposite the substitution zones, each team on the same side as its own bench. A penalised player goes here; the secretariat keeps the time and writes the match record.
Soutěže mládeže se často hrají na menším: Youth competitions in Czechia are often played on a smaller rink. Its dimensions are set by the regulations of each competition.
Nejmladší kategorie hrají jen ve formátu: The youngest age groups play only

An attacker charges at the goal with the ball.
V zápalu šlápne do malého brankoviště. P: In the heat of the moment a foot lands in the goalkeeper area. A foot on the line counts too.
Hvizd. Ruce nad hlavou ve tvaru trojúhel: Whistle. Arms above the head forming a triangle signal an offence in the goalkeeper area.
Volný úder dostává bránící tým a soupeři: The defending team gets a free-hit and the opponents must move 3 m away. Reaching into the area with the stick would have been fine.
Na hřišti je za každé družstvo nejvýš še: Each team has at most six players on the rink: usually five field players and one goalkeeper. The others wait in the substitution zone and rotate all the time.
Za tým hraje nejvýš šest hráčů naráz. Mí: A team plays with at most six players at once. Only the goalkeeper may catch the ball with the hands.
hráčů nejvýš na soupisce: players at most in the match record
nejvýš na hřišti naráz: at most on the rink at once
nejméně na hřišti, i při trestech: at least on the rink, even with penalties
Kdykoli během hry, i za pohybu. Hráč, kt: At any time during play, even on the fly. The player leaving must cross the board first; only then may the new one enter the rink.
Družstvo může kdykoli hrát se šesti hráč: A team may play with six field players and no goalkeeper at any time. Typically late in the game when it is losing.
Only the captain may talk to the referees.
Trenéři a další členové týmu, nejvýš pět: Coaches and other team members, five at most. They stand behind the players’ bench; only one of them may step in front of it, to give instructions to the players on the rink.
Hráči sedí na lavici a nikdo nesmí dát n: Players sit on the bench and nobody may put a foot on the board. The referees warn first; a repeat costs 2 minutes. The aim is not to punish but to make the atmosphere in the hall more pleasant.
Hráči s florbalkou mají trika, trenýrky: Field players wear shirts, shorts and knee socks of the same colour; only the goalkeeper wears long trousers. Jewellery is forbidden and taping it over is not enough. A bleeding player, or one with blood on the equipment, must stay out of play until it is sorted out.
Chytá rukama a nemá florbalku: Catches with the hands and has no stick
Brankář klečí v bráně v masce a chytá mí: The goalkeeper kneels in the goal wearing a face mask and stops the ball with hands and body. A few extra rules apply:
Musí zůstat ve velkém brankovišti. Když: Must stay in the goal crease. Having left it completely, the goalkeeper counts as a field player without a stick and may not catch the ball with the hands.
Míček smí držet nejvýš: May hold the ball for at most
Výhozem ani výkopem nesmí poslat míček v: May not throw or kick the ball through the air over the centre line.
Nesmí vzít do ruky úmyslnou přihrávku od: May not pick up an intentional pass from a teammate.
Výhozem smí sám dát gól, nikdo další se: May score directly with a throw; nobody else needs to touch the ball.
Zápas řídí dva rozhodčí s píšťalkou. Pom: A match is led by two referees with whistles. They are assisted by the match secretariat, which keeps the time and penalties and writes the match record.
Musí mít schválení IFF. Čepel se smí zah: It must be IFF-approved. The blade may be hooked by 30 mm at most. The ball is plastic with holes.
Hráč dojíždí ke střídačce a hlásí střídá: A player arrives at the substitution zone and calls for a change.
Nejdřív musí mantinel přelézt ten, kdo o: The player leaving must cross the board first. The new player waits.
Teprve pak smí na hřiště nový hráč. Stří: Only then may the new player enter the rink. You can substitute at any time, as often as you like.
Kdo naskočí dřív a zasáhne do hry, jde n: Jump in too early and affect play, and it is 2 minutes for incorrect substitution.
Brankář chytí míček do rukou. Začíná odp: The goalkeeper catches the ball. The count begins.
Míček smí držet nejvýš 3 sekundy. Hledá: The ball may be held for 3 seconds at most. The goalkeeper looks for a free teammate.
Výhoz ke spoluhráči. Vzduchem za půlku a: A throw to a teammate. The ball must not fly over the centre line through the air, though. That would be a free-hit for the opponents.
Zápas má tři třetiny po 20 minutách. Čas: A match has three periods of 20 minutes. Time is effective: it stops at every whistle and starts again when play resumes. That is why a match lasts longer than an hour.
Only the time when the game is actually being played counts.
Časová osa: 20 minut hry, 10 minut přest: Timeline: 20 minutes of play, 10-minute break, 20 minutes of play, 10-minute break, 20 minutes of play
začátek: vhazování ve středu: start: face-off at the centre spot
po každé třetině si týmy mění strany: teams change ends after each period
Zapískejte a sledujte hodiny: Blow the whistle and watch the clocks
Čas na tabuli běží, jen když se hraje. T: The scoreboard clock runs only while the game is being played. Real time never stops. Here both run ten times faster.
Každé družstvo si smí za zápas vzít jede: Each team may take one time out per match. The captain or the coach can request it.
Jen když musí být znám vítěz. Kdo první: Only when a winner is needed. The first team to score wins and the game ends at once.
Když nerozhodne ani prodloužení, jde pět: If overtime does not decide it either, five players from each team go one-on-one against the goalkeeper. If it is still level, they continue one shot each until one team leads.
Mládežnické a nižší soutěže mohou hrát k: Youth and lower-level competitions may play shorter periods, at least 2 × 15 minutes.
Proč zápas trvá déle než hodinu: Why a match lasts longer than an hour
The game is on and the scoreboard clock is running.
The referee blows the whistle and the clock stops.
Hodiny se rozběhnou, až se zase hraje. T: The clock starts again when play resumes. Here after a face-off.
Hraje se čistý čas, proto zápas trvá dél: Time is effective, so the match takes longer than the clock shows.
Florbal je bezkontaktní hra. Nesmí se st: Floorball is a non-contact game. No pushing, no hitting the opponent’s stick and no high play. A lighter offence means a free-hit for the opponents, a more serious one a bench penalty.
You fight for the ball with the stick, not the body. The stick stays low, and neither the opponent nor the opponent’s stick may be pushed, hit or held.
Lehčí faul. Míček dostane soupeř, hraje: A lighter offence. The opponents get the ball and both teams stay at full strength.
Menší trest. Vyloučení na trestnou lavic: Minor bench penalty. The player goes to the penalty bench and the team plays short-handed.
Větší trest. Dvě dvouminutovky po sobě,: Major bench penalty. Two 2-minute penalties in a row; an opponents’ goal cancels only one.
Osobní trest. Tým je oslaben jen 2 minut: Personal penalty. The team is short-handed for 2 minutes only; the offender sits longer.
The player is out for the rest of the match.
Faul zmařil jasnou šanci na gól, hráč jd: An offence spoiled a clear scoring chance; one player goes alone against the goalkeeper.
Posuňte míček nahoru a dolů a sledujte,: Move the ball up and down and see when the referee would blow the whistle.
Hráč zvedá florbalku s míčkem do různé v: A player raises the stick with the ball to different heights
Výška míčku při zahrání: Height of the ball when played
Čepel florbalky nad pasem při nápřahu ne: Stick blade above waist level in the back swing or after a shot, with an opponent nearby
Hrát míček florbalkou nad koleny: Playing the ball with the stick above knee level
Hrát míček nohou nad koleny: Playing the ball with the foot above knee level
Zahrát míček florbalkou nebo nohou nad p: Playing the ball with the stick or foot above waist level
Měří se podle výšky kolen a pasu hráče v: Measured by the player’s knee and waist level when standing upright.
Velký nápřah nad pas je v pořádku, když: A big back swing above the waist is fine when nobody is nearby.
Stejný nápřah, ale hned za hráčem stojí: The same swing, but an opponent is right behind the player. Free-hit.
Zahrát míček florbalkou nad úrovní pasu: Playing the ball with the stick above waist level costs 2 minutes.
Sekat, blokovat, nadzvedávat nebo kopat: Hitting, blocking, lifting or kicking an opponent’s stick. If it gains a considerable advantage or the player had no chance of reaching the ball, it is
Povolený je jen souboj ramenem na rameno: Only a shoulder-to-shoulder challenge is allowed. Pushing in any other way or backing into an opponent is an offence. Pushing an opponent against the board costs
Chytat, tahat nebo držet soupeře či jeho: Grabbing, pulling or holding an opponent or the opponent’s stick. Taking hold of the opponent’s stick with a hand already means
Florbalka nebo noha mezi nohy: Stick or foot between the legs
Vložit florbalku, nohu nebo chodidlo mez: Placing the stick, foot or leg between an opponent’s legs.
Hrát míček, když hráč klečí na obou kole: Playing the ball while kneeling on both knees or leaning on the floor with the hand that is not holding the stick.
Jumping up with both feet and stopping the ball. Jumping over it is fine.
Playing the ball with the head is forbidden.
Hráč s florbalkou nesmí zastavit ani zah: A field player must not stop or play the ball with a hand, an arm or a stretched-out shirt.
Hráč s florbalkou do něj nesmí vstoupit: A field player must not step into it or run through it. A defender standing there when a free-hit is shot straight at the goal means a
Při volném úderu nebo rozehrání musí sou: At a free-hit or hit-in the opponents must move at least 3 m from the ball, sticks included.
Hádání s rozhodčími nebo rušivé pokyny z: Arguing with the referees or disturbing coaching from the bench. Misconduct, provocative celebrations and diving are punished even more severely.
Útočník se musí ve velkém brankovišti sn: Inside the goal crease an attacker must try to avoid the goalkeeper. Contact the attacker made no effort to prevent is careless play.
Běžné clonění je v pořádku. Faul je, kdy: Ordinary screening is fine. It is an offence when an attacker actively and repeatedly follows the goalkeeper’s movements only to obscure the view.
Trest navíc pro toho, kdo potyčku vyvola: An extra penalty for whoever started the scuffle. At most one player can get it, even when nobody is penalised for the scuffle itself.
Zaháknout florbalkou soupeřovo tělo, hod: Hooking an opponent’s body with the stick, throwing the stick at the ball or recklessly knocking an opponent over.
Ramenem na rameno o míček: dovolený soub: Shoulder to shoulder for the ball: a fair challenge.
Strčit soupeře rukama do zad je faul a n: Pushing an opponent in the back with the hands is an offence, followed by a free-hit.
Natlačit soupeře na mantinel stojí 2 min: Pushing an opponent against the board costs 2 minutes.
Zastavit míček tělem, třeba stehnem nebo: Stopping the ball with the body, for example the thigh or chest (not the head or a hand).
Přihrát nohou pod úrovní kolen. Kopnutý: Passing with the foot below knee level. A kicked goal does not count, though.
A shoulder-to-shoulder challenge for the ball.
Hrát florbalkou do soupeřovy florbalky p: Hitting the opponent’s stick after playing the ball cleanly first.
A high back swing when nobody is nearby.
Běžet za mantinelem. Míček odtud ale hrá: Running outside the board. You must not play the ball from there, though.
Když rozhodčí přeruší hru, pokračuje se: When the referees stop play, it resumes with one of four fixed situations. Which one depends on why play was stopped.
Kdo se proviní, přichází o míček. Rozhod: Whoever commits the offence loses the ball. The referees do not blow the whistle when stopping play would hurt the team that was fouled.
Dva hráči se postaví proti sobě a o míče: Two players face each other and contest the ball placed between their blades. Everyone else stands at least 3 m away. It starts every period and restarts play after a goal.
Míček přeletěl mantinel. Rozehrává družs: The ball went over the board. The team that did not touch it last takes the hit-in, 1.5 m from the board where the ball went out. The ball must be hit, not dragged.
Po faulu. Hraje se z místa přestupku, ne: After an offence. Taken where it happened, at least 3.5 m from the goalkeeper area. The defending team may form a wall. A free-hit may go straight into the goal.
Obránce faulem zmařil jasnou šanci na gó: A defender’s offence spoiled a clear scoring chance. A player goes alone against the goalkeeper from an imaginary spot 5 m from the centre line and must keep moving towards the goal. Starting with the foot or a “zorro” move is not allowed.
Proč rozhodčí nepískl?: Why didn’t the referee blow the whistle?
Když faulovaný tým má míček dál pod kont: When the fouled team still controls the ball and playing on suits it better, the referee lets play continue and just holds out an arm with the palm up. That is called advantage.
Výhoda: proč rozhodčí nepískl: Advantage: why the referee did not whistle
Obránce sekne útočníkovi do florbalky. M: A defender hits the attacker’s stick. But the attacker keeps the ball.
Rozhodčí nepíská. Natáhne ruku dlaní vzh: No whistle. The referee holds out an arm, palm up, and lets play continue.
Útok pokračuje a padne gól. Kdyby rozhod: The attack goes on and a goal is scored. Had the referee blown the whistle, the fouled team would have lost its chance.
Za vážnější fauly jde hráč na trestnou l: For more serious offences a player goes to the penalty bench. Meanwhile the team plays short-handed, one player fewer. The opponents are on a power play.
Čím vážnější prohřešek, tím déle tým hra: The more serious the offence, the longer the team plays without the offender.
Lehčí faul: sekání do florbalky, strkání: A lighter offence: hitting the stick, pushing, playing the ball with the foot above knee level.
Neopatrná hra, hra rukou, špatné střídán: Careless play, hand ball, incorrect substitution, protests. When the opponents score on the power play, the penalty ends.
Bezohledná hra, hákování. Gól soupeře zr: Reckless play, hooking. An opponents’ goal cancels only one of the two 2-minute penalties.
Nesportovní chování, provokativní oslavy: Misconduct, provocative celebrations, diving. The team is short-handed for 2 minutes only; the offender sits the full 12 and returns only at the next interruption.
Hrubé nesportovní chování, násilí, rvačk: Gross misconduct, violence, fighting, a second major bench penalty. The player leaves for the dressing room and the team serves 2 + 2 min. A suspension for the next match usually follows. A red card can be given even after the final siren while players are still on the rink.
sedí jen hráč, na hřišti ho nahradí spol: only the player sits; a teammate takes the place on the rink
hráč do konce utkání mimo hru: player out for the rest of the match
Udělte červeným trest a sledujte, kolik: Give the red team a penalty and watch how many players stay on the rink. Then try scoring for the blue team.
Schéma hřiště se dvěma týmy, střídačkami: Diagram of a rink with two teams, substitution zones and a penalty bench
Faulovaný tým má míček, a tak rozhodčí z: The fouled team has the ball, so the referee raises an arm and lets it attack. The penalty is given once the offenders gain the ball or play stops. Meanwhile the fouled team may pull its goalkeeper.
Nejvýš dva naráz: Two at a time at most
Vždy aspoň čtyři na hřišti: Always at least four on the rink
Družstvu se měří nejvýš dva tresty souča: No more than two penalties per team are timed at once. Even with more players penalised, the team keeps at least four on the rink; the others wait on the bench for their turn.
Dostanou-li tresty hráči obou týmů ve st: If players of both teams are penalised during the same interruption, the 2-minute penalties on each side are added up. Whatever balances out does not change the number of players on the rink and is not cancelled by a goal. For example, 2 + 2 against 2 minutes means a power play for 2 minutes only.
Gól zruší nejkratší trest: A goal cancels the shortest penalty
Má-li tým na lavici víc vyloučených, gól: When a team has several players on the penalty bench, an opponents’ goal ends the penalty with the least time left. It used to be the one awarded first.
Hráč s míčkem je podražen. Rozhodčí zved: The player with the ball is tripped. The referee raises an arm, but play goes on.
Faulovaný tým útočí dál a může stáhnout: The fouled team keeps attacking and may pull its goalkeeper. A sixth field player jumps in instead.
Jakmile míček získá tým, který fauloval,: As soon as the offending team gains the ball, the referee blows the whistle.
Faulující hráč jde na 2 minuty na trestn: The offender goes to the penalty bench for 2 minutes. Had a goal been scored in the meantime, the 2-minute penalty would not have been given.
Červený hráč sedí 2 minuty na trestné la: A red player sits on the penalty bench for 2 minutes. Blue are on a power play.
Blue score on the power play.
Gól ukončí menší trest, i když z něj zbý: The goal ends the minor penalty even with more than a minute left. The penalised player returns straight away.
Gól platí, když míček celým objemem přej: A goal counts when the whole ball crosses the goal line from the front after being played correctly with the stick. It is confirmed with a face-off at the centre spot.
Gól se dává florbalkou. Úmyslně nohou an: Goals are scored with the stick. An attacker cannot score intentionally with a foot or the body.
Posuňte míček přes čáru: Slide the ball across the line
Kdy přesně je to gól? Pohled shora na br: When exactly is it a goal? A view of the goal line from above.
Poloha míčku vůči brankové čáře: Position of the ball relative to the goal line
Míček je celý za čárou, ne jen dotýká se: The whole ball is over the line, not just touching it.
Střelec ho zahrál florbalkou. Gól může v: The scorer played it with the stick. The goalkeeper can score too, with a throw, even if nobody else touches the ball.
Míček se do branky odrazil od obránce, n: The ball bounced into the goal off a defender, or a defender knocked it in (own goal).
Útočník ho do branky neúmyslně tečoval t: An attacker unintentionally deflected it into the goal with the body.
Tým bez brankáře zmaří soupeři šanci fau: A team playing without a goalkeeper spoils the opponents’ chance with an offence. Instead of a penalty shot, a goal is awarded straight away.
Útočník míček úmyslně kopl nebo usměrnil: An attacker intentionally kicked the ball or directed it with the body.
The attacking team committed an offence just before.
Míček přešel čáru až po hvizdu nebo siré: The ball crossed the line after the whistle or the siren.
Míček se do branky dostal zezadu nebo ze: The ball entered the goal from behind or from the side.
Skóroval tým, kterému se právě odkládá t: The team that scored had a penalty being delayed against it, or had too many players on the rink.
An attacker kicks the ball into the goal.
The ball is in the net and the attacker celebrates.
Předčasně. Úmyslně kopnutý míček se nepo: Too soon. An intentionally kicked ball does not count, and the referee holds both arms out to the sides.
Nejde o faul, a tak se pokračuje vhazová: It is not an offence, so play resumes with a face-off at the nearest dot.
Po hvizdu rozhodčí nejdřív ukáže, jak se: After the whistle the referee first shows how play will resume and then, where needed, what for. These are the signs you will see most often.
Klepněte na kartu a ukáže se, co signál: Tap a card to reveal what the sign means.
Šest situací ze hřiště. Podívejte se na: Six situations from the rink. Look at the picture and decide like a referee. What is your call?
Slova, která uslyšíte od komentátorů a z: Words you will hear from commentators and from the stands.
That word is not in the glossary.
Náčiní s dlouhou násadou a plastovou zah: The implement with a long shaft and a hooked plastic blade used to play the ball.
Každý hráč kromě brankáře, tedy ten, kdo: Any player other than the goalkeeper, that is, one who plays with a stick.
Nízká plastová zeď kolem hřiště se zaobl: A low plastic wall with rounded corners around the rink.
Dva obdélníky před brankou: velké je úze: Two rectangles in front of the goal: the larger goal crease is the goalkeeper’s territory, and field players must stay out of the smaller goalkeeper area.
Souboj dvou hráčů o míček položený mezi: A contest between two players for the ball placed between their blades.
Pokračování hry po tom, co míček opustil: The restart after the ball has left the rink.
Pokračování hry po faulu z místa přestup: The restart after an offence, taken where it happened.
Samostatný nájezd jednoho hráče na brank: One player going alone against the goalkeeper.
Hraní s menším, nebo naopak větším počte: Playing with fewer or, on the other side, more players while someone is serving a penalty.
Rozhodčí nechá hrát dál, protože přeruše: The referee lets play continue because stopping it would hurt the fouled team.
The clock runs only while the game is actually being played.
Oficiální dokument se soupiskami, góly a: The official document with the team lists, goals and penalties.
